name: rollcall_vhunter
about: Roll call: classname npc_VHunter builds CNPC_VHunter (factory 0x10387f60, research/tooling/ghidra/driver/kernel_factories.tsv). No map places it directly; makers name it in NPCType (12 rows). sm_hub_1's hunter_maker_1 (NPCType npc_VHunter, NPCTargetname hunter_1) stands verbatim and its Spawn input makes the child through CNPCMaker (0x1034aae0); the child then runs NPCThink 0x10292de0 -> RunAI 0x1026f110 -> MaintainSchedule: SelectSchedule picks a program and SetSchedule 0x10280e50 installs it, and the program runs for the rest of the ten seconds without a task failing every think.
notes: The maker carries OnSpawnNPC -> hunter_stalk_enable_relay.Trigger; the relay is not stood, so the output's target is absent (the output event still fires).
